owner_scope: Explicitly approved combined confirmation entry plus exact5m signal-extreme stop. Preserve V2.37 MTF event eligibility and H1 qualification only in15m cohort, not full Langlang main-wave system.
anchor: 5m cohort original5m arrow;15m cohort its frozen matched5m arrow. Original arrow candle low for long, high for short, no buffer. Not the later confirmation candle.
confirmation: Next3 complete5m bars may touch but cannot strictly break anchor extreme. Starting fourth later bar, first bullish close strictly above prior high for long, bearish close strictly below prior low for short. Latch this turn; decision=max(turn close,pair publication), provided no intervening strict extreme break. No added expiry or retries.
entry: Next actual5m open after decision. If opening quote is at/beyond frozen stop or risk<one tick, cancel. No later open-bar OHLC is used for selection. Original first-year setups must complete within their year; end-of-data incomplete windows counted separately.
execution: Existing Nautilus1.231.0 HEDGING/market/protective-stop engine. Observed open point at open+1ns then unchanged5mOHLC, to protect entry candle.1ns orders events only; no new market price. Single stop barrier, OHLC endpoint ordering does not affect outcome. No shared adapter changes.
exit: Native initial stop or exactly120minutes after actual open; no TP, BE, ATR, H1 exit or partials. R is actual fill-to-signal-extreme risk. Fee20bp/newrisk; independent equal-price-risk returns, not funded-account PnL.
controls: Frozen matched same-symbol/side/year/UTCweek/causalATRbucket/clock-phase preparation points. Translate original5m-anchor lag to each random point and apply SAME confirmation to its OWN candle extreme. Keep rejected opportunities as0R in paired comparisons; per-filled winrates have separate denominators. Matching is at preparation, not future confirmation time.
validation: Feature boundary/mirror/prefix/future-entryOHLC invariance tests; native next-open difference, entry-bar stops, opening gaps,120min close and exact fee audits. First/later chronological years reported separately. Holm over8strategy-control and4strategy-baseline tests. Reused history is not unseen validation.
